fusions.name: Rolled Slam
fusions.desc: You curl up and roll over the ground, dealing 16 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Flaked Plate
fusions.desc: Pops a flake of rock free that deals 8 damage and costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Seamless Hide
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 35% and your rock resistance by 15% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Layer on Layer
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
